pages.title: Black Wildebeest
pages.text: The black wildebeest ($(o)Connochaetes gnou$()), or white-tailed gnu, lives on the open grasslands of southern Africa.$(br2)It is dark brown, with an upright bristly mane, a long white tail and horns that hook forward and down before curving up.$(br2)Hunted almost to extinction in the 1800s, it survived on a few farms and has since recovered.
